pages.text: Foods can be set down as a block: Shift + right click on a solid block while holding the food.$(br2)Placed, they show their plate or board; in hand and inventory they do not.

Right click a placed food to eat it (nutrition and effects included).$(br2)Shift + right click with empty hands picks it up.$(br2)The asado is eaten in four bites: the effects arrive with the last one, and once started it can no longer be picked up.
